1.explanation:
• FileUploaderDropContainer.js: Contains the actual JSX that nests the <input> inside a <div role=“button”>, which is the root cause.  
• FileUploaderDropContainer-test.js: The test where the axe violation is triggered once the axe-core dependency is updated.  
• FileUploader.js: Shows how DropContainer is composed into the higher-level FileUploader API.  
• jest-config-carbon/package.json: Defines the axe-core version range; bumping to ^4.2.0 is required to reproduce the violation.  
• test-helpers.js: Provides helpers used in the tests, including any axe setup.  
• FileUploader.mdx: The documentation page for FileUploader, useful to see intended usage patterns and props that may affect accessibility.
1.bug_scenario:

wrapper around a native , nesting two focusable/interactive elements. In the failure screenshot you can see the generated DOM fragment:

This violates WCAG 4.1.2 (“nested interactive controls”), causing automated axe tests to fail. The issue appears in the FileUploaderDropContainer component’s render logic and is caught when the test suite is run after upgrading axe-core to v4.2.0+ and adding an axe check in the jest test.
